description: Razvoj metodologije za oceno razvitosti erozijskih procesov in kartiranje erozijske nevarnosti na območjih poplavljanja celinskih voda in morja - Študija is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. As an important element of the definition of flood risk, the remote concept of flood risk management should also include an assessment of the development of erosion processes related to the properties of flood waters. Coverage: MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. The portal shows the English title as "Development of a methodology for assessing the development of erosion processes and mapping erosion hazards in inland wa" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. Its keywords include hidromelioracije, obalna erozija. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
